payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Delisa, Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene, Tonya

payload.content: Raylene planning: my cheapest/highest-value options are ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.90, medium) > ISSUE-0002::test (2.66, medium) > ISSUE-0002::implement (3.80, medium). ISSUE-0001 tasks are very expensive for me (10-20), so I prefer not to take them unless needed to maximize tasks_done. Tentative preference order: 0002::review, then 0002::test, then 0002::implement. Please share your best low-cost claims so we can avoid duplicates.

Delisa planning (iter 1): I have 9h availability and strong api-development skill (0.83). My cheapest feasible options are all ISSUE-0001 tasks: review/docs/triage cost 1.94 each, test 2.71, implement 3.87. ISSUE-0002 tasks are very expensive for me: review 10.00, test 14.00, implement 20.00. So I strongly prefer taking one of the ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks and leaving ISSUE-0002 to others like Raylene. Tentative preference order for me: ISSUE-0001::review / docs / triage (tie), then ISSUE-0001::test, then ISSUE-0001::implement. If others have even cheaper ISSUE-0001 options, please say so to avoid collisions.

Mackenzie planning (iter 1): availability 5h, strongest skill mobile-development (0.62). My feasible/cheap options are all ISSUE-0002 tasks: review cost 2.44, test 3.42, implement 4.88. ISSUE-0001 tasks are very expensive for me (review/docs/triage 10.00, test 14.00, implement 20.00), so I strongly prefer taking one ISSUE-0002 micro-task and leaving ISSUE-0001 to api/infrastructure-strong agents like Delisa. Since Raylene is even cheaper than me on ISSUE-0002::review/test/implement, my tentative preference is ISSUE-0002::test or ISSUE-0002::implement if Raylene takes review; otherwise I can take review if needed. Current preference order to avoid duplicates: 0002::test, then 0002::implement, then 0002::review. Please share if anyone else is also specialized for 0002.

If no one else is covering 0001 triage/docs, I’m happy to take one of those.
